scripts.deploy: CLOUDFLARE_ENV= react-router build && CLOUDFLARE_ENV= NODE_ENV=production WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:preview: CLOUDFLARE_ENV=preview react-router build && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=preview WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:version: CLOUDFLARE_ENV= react-router build && CLOUDFLARE_ENV= wrangler versions upload
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typegen && pnpm tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.postinstall: node -e "process.exit(require('node:fs').existsSync('wrangler.jsonc') ? 0 : 1)" && pnpm run typegen || echo 'skipped typegen: no wrangler.jsonc yet (run pnpm setup:workspace)'
